# SWriteMapR65

**Author:** Siemens<br/>
**Platforms:** x65/x75 (SGOLD)

<img
  className="screenshot"
  src={require("./swrite-map-r65/img/swrite-map-r65.png").default}
  alt={"SWriteMapR65: screenshot 1"}
/>

Siemens service utility for writing standard and delta MAP files to the
EEPROM of x75 series phones. Communicates with the phone via the COM port in BFB Mode;
Factory Mode and Developer Mode are supported.

The archive includes the NI LabWindows/CVI runtime environment required to run the
program.

## Versions

- **1.04** — [SWriteMapR65-1.04.zip](https://git.siepatch.dev/siepatch/soft/media/branch/main/catalog/service/swrite-map-r65/files/SWriteMapR65-1.04.zip)<br/>Windows 32-bit · 1.28 MiB
